fluff.overview: Under the reforms of Precentor Martial Anastasius Focht, Com Guard infantry train extensively in combined-arms cooperation, conducting regular exercises alongside heavier elements to ensure seamless coordination across all branches when battle demands it. Foot infantry Level I formations anchor defensive positions and garrison critical installations, providing the persistent ground presence that BattleMech and armor units cannot maintain indefinitely. Com Guard foot infantry train alongside heavier elements and understand their role within the larger combined-arms framework. Armed with standard ballistic assault rifles, the most common and affordable infantry weapon in the Inner Sphere, these troops deliver reliable short-range firepower and can be equipped and resupplied from almost any garrison stockpile.
